issue.title: Add Translation Notes Section to Resources Tab
issue.body: This ticket builds the Translation Notes section of the Resources tab, the first content section and the uW resource type already validated on web. It covers displaying tN content for the active unit, along with the section's own error/retry handling when its content fails to load. ## Functional Requirements ### Translation Notes Section - Display uW Translation Notes for the active unit at the top of the Resources tab. - Make the section itself a top-level accordion (li:chevron-down), collapsed by default, that the translator taps to reveal its contents. - Label the section "Translation Notes", with an open book icon (li:book-open) to the left of the title. - Display each Translation Note as its own accordion (li:chevron-down) within the section, one per verse or passage covered by the active unit, collapsed by default until tapped. - Preserve source formatting such as paragraphs and lists inside each note's accordion content. - Hide the section entirely when no Translation Notes are available for the unit. ### Error Handling - Show an inline error with a Retry button scoped to the Translation Notes section if its content fails to load. - Don't let a Translation Notes load failure block the Translation Questions or Images & Maps sections from displaying. --- ## Engineering context *(Added for implementation readiness. Product requirements above remain the source of truth.)* ### Product intent (summary) Show uW Translation Notes for the active drafting unit at the top of Resources: section accordion (collapsed by default), nested per-note accordions with preserved formatting, hide when empty, isolated error/retry. ### Proposed technical approach 1. Build `TranslationNotesSection` under `src/app/tabs/resources/` (or similar), mounted from `ResourcesTab` (#188). 2. Read notes for the active unit from **local** queries once a resource store exists; do not block other sections on failure. 3. Nested accordions: section-level + one accordion per note/passage; default collapsed. 4. Render note HTML/Markdown-like structure with paragraphs/lists preserved (choose an existing RN-safe renderer used elsewhere, or a minimal subset — see Open questions). 5. Section-scoped error + Retry that re-invokes the section loader only. ### Systems / modules / anchors - Host: `src/app/tabs/ResourcesTab.tsx`, `DraftingContext` unit selection - Accordion patterns: `SourceTextAccordion`, prepare-offline accordions - Data: **no TN tables/API on `main` today** — needs schema/queries + fluent-api contract (recommend shared data-layer ticket) - Types: extend `src/types/` for note DTOs / DB rows - Offline fill: #192 / Prepare Offline #51/#201 ### Implementation steps 1. Agree note model + query keyed by unit (with data-layer / API contract). 2. Implement section UI + nested accordions + formatting. 3. Wire hide-when-empty; contribute “has content” signal to #188 empty host. 4. Error/retry isolation tests. 5. Manual QA on Android for accordion UX and formatting. ### Dependencies & prerequisites - **In-repo:** #188 shell (mount point). Prefer shared resource data layer before or with this ticket. Full offline guarantee: #192 (+ #201 inventory). - **External:** fluent-api (or upstream) must provide uW Translation Notes for project/unit — **mention only**; do not implement in API repo from this ticket. Align with web’s validated tN display if a reference UI exists in fluent-web. ### Edge cases & failure states - Partial note list: show what loaded; don’t infinite-spinner the section. - Malformed formatting: degrade to plain text rather than crash. - Unit change mid-fetch: ignore stale results (key requests by unit). - Empty notes: hide section entirely (not an error). ### Testing & verification - Component tests: collapsed defaults, hide when empty, error+retry, isolation from sibling sections. - Manual: formatting samples with lists/paragraphs. - Gates: format → lint → typecheck → test. ### Analytics / observability / migrations - SQLite tables/migrations if owned here or by shared data-layer ticket. - Log load failures with unit ids only. ### Assumptions - “uW Translation Notes” content parity with web is expected; exact field mapping awaits API contract. - Default collapsed applies to both section and inner note accordions. ### Open questions 1. API/DB shape for tN (per verse vs passage; language/resource catalog id)? 2. Which formatting subset must be preserved (Markdown, USFM, HTML)? 3. Who owns the shared resource tables — this ticket, #192, or a new data-layer ticket? ### Acceptance criteria - [ ] Translation Notes section appears at top of Resources for the active unit when notes exist. - [ ] Section is a top-level accordion, collapsed by default, labeled “Translation Notes” with book-open icon. - [ ] Each note is its own nested accordion, collapsed by default, with paragraphs/lists preserved. - [ ] Section hidden when no notes for the unit. - [ ] Section-scoped error + Retry; failures do not block Questions or Images & Maps. - [ ] Tests cover hide/empty, accordion defaults, and error isolation.
